title: Bontsi jo bo Nyeletseng
intro: O eme fa pele ga medumo ya morafe o kgang ya one e kwadilweng mo makhubung. Mewa eno e ne ya utlwa pitso, ya tlhopha go gana, mme ya lebana le ditlamorago tse di neng tsa bopa lefatshe sesha. Ke bomang, mme go ne ga diragala eng ka lefatshe la bone?
clues: Re tshedile bogologolo tala, mme morongwa a tla kwa go rona a tswa mo gare ga rona.
Re ne re obamela medingwana e le metlhano mme ra gana go e tlogela.
Re ne ra sotla morongwa yono mme ra mo latofatsa ka gore o timetse.
Re ne re batla gore a tlise kotlhao fa a ne a bua boammaaruri.
Re ne ra bona magodimo a tsholola pula le lefatshe le tshologa metswedi.
Re ne ra tlhatlogela kwa mafelong a a kwa godimo go tshaba, mme makhubu a ne a re feta.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Re ne ra nwediwa ke morwalela o mogolo
Re bolailwe ke go thunya go go kwa godimo
Re ne ra konopiwa ka matlapa go tswa kwa loaping
trial.answer: Re ne ra nwediwa ke morwalela o mogolo

outcome.label: Botso
options: Rotlhe re ne ra nyelela fa e se badumedi le Nuh .
Re ne ra fetolwa go nna ditshwene
Re ne ra tlogelwa re le matlotla a batsamai
outcome.answer: Rotlhe re ne ra nyelela fa e se badumedi le Nuh .

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
